# Worksheet solutions

These are the worked worksheets from the live sessions, not the numbered chapter
exercises. The two sets ask different questions on purpose: the chapter exercises
in [Appendix G](solutions.qmd) are reading-and-study material, while the
worksheets are what participants fill in during a session. Each part below keeps
the worksheet's code and condenses the written answers to the points that matter.

Days 1 and 2 are covered here; Day 3 will follow.
